name: mx-bikes-manager
description: Manage installed MX Bikes mods and browse/install mods from mxb-mods.com
author: rare621

scripts.build:win: npm run build:assets && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/release-checksums.js
